CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_game_export_start(p_club_id uuid, p_start date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_end date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_game text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_stakes text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recent'::text, p_request_id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid())
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$BEGIN
  IF public.fn_ca_club_data_reads_union_basis(p_club_id, p_start, p_end) THEN
    RETURN public.ca_club_game_export_start_union_basis(p_club_id, p_start, p_end, p_game, p_stakes, p_search, p_sort, p_request_id);
  END IF;
  RETURN public.ca_club_game_export_start_chicago_basis(p_club_id, p_start, p_end, p_game, p_stakes, p_search, p_sort, p_request_id);
END;$function$
